task.title: M3: Import extraction query and baseline TS resolver
task.description:
Add import extraction to the walker as a per-language tree-sitter query and implement the baseline TypeScript/JavaScript resolver that needs only Node: relative specifiers resolve to files (with extension and index probing), tsconfig paths and baseUrl are honored, and bare package specifiers resolve to external. Emit file-level edges[] { from, to, kind: 'import', level: 'file' } and modules[] as directories (kind: 'dir'). Resolution is kept separate from extraction so a precise resolver can replace it later.

Acceptance criteria:
- The TS/TSX/JS language config carries an import query covering import, export-from, dynamic import(), and require().
- resolveTs(fromFile, specifier, ctx) returns { kind: 'file', path } | { kind: 'module', id } | { kind: 'external', name } and handles .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs, index files, and tsconfig paths with wildcards.
- modules[] contains one dir entry per directory that holds analyzed files, with its file list.
- Capacitor's snapshot has file-level edges and a sanity-checked count of unresolved specifiers reported as a warning.
- Fixture tests cover relative, paths-alias, package, and unresolvable imports.
